tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha snyan brgyud zab mo gu ru zhi ba'i skor las rtsa gsum spyi'i las byang bzhugs so:
gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sarba sid+dhi hūm̐:
rtsa gsum spyi yi las byang gzhung bsrang ni: sta gon rim pa spyi dang mthun par bya: de nas 'don sgom sbrags la 'di ltar bya'o:

hūm̐: nga ni khro bo dbang chen te: bgegs dang log 'dren nga la nyon: nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed: nga yi bka' las 'da' byed na: bdag nyid nga rgyal thugs khros te: thal ba rdul du brlag par byed: de bas da lta phyir dengs shig: oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha hūm̐:
sogs/
hūm̐: nga ni
che ge
ste: thugs kar gser gyi gwa 'u'i nang: bdag cag dpon slob bsrung bya tshud: steng 'og rdo rje'i gur sar gyur: oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: hūm̐: ma grub bar du dkyil 'khor mi gtong na: yi dam
che ge
'i lha tshogs ma lus rnams: srog la bab kyang bdag gis gzung bar bgyi: bdag gis dam tshig gtong bar mi bgyid do: hūm̐:
che ga

'i lha tshogs ma lus rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen dbab tu gsol: skal ldan dad ldan bdag la dbang mchog skur: log 'dren tshe yi bar chad bsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra ā we sha ya ā: oṃ āḥm hā pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥthā: oṃ āḥm hā ba liṃ ta hūm̐ hrīḥthā: oṃ āḥm hā rak+ta hūm̐ hrīḥthā: oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan dhe nai wid+yā shab+da āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad dang: chos skyong nor lha kun gyi thugs dang ni: 'gal bar gyur pa ma lus ci mchis pa: bdag gis gnong zhing 'gyod pas mthol lo bshags: badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe ā: hūm̐: chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems las byung: sems nyid ye nas stong pa nyid kyi ngang: sems can kun gyis de don ma rtogs pas: 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can snying re rje: chos rnams thams cad rten 'brel rgyu las byung: hūm̐ ni rgyu yi sa bon nyid du gsal: de las raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum 'phros pa yis: raṃ gyi mes bsregs yaṃ gi rlung gis gtor: khaṃ gi chus bkrus stong pa nyid du gsal: e yaṃ khaṃ gsum bh+rūm̐ gyi yi ge yis: rang byung 'byung ba chen po lnga chags te: mkha' rlung chu dang ri rab gser gyi ri: de steng bh+rūm̐ gyi yi ge las bskyed pa'i: gzhal yas khang ni sgo gru rta babs rdzogs: gdugs tog chos 'khor ri dwags pad 'dab mtshan:
rdor ra ye shes lnga yi me ri 'bar: bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe e dzñā na tsakra maṇ+ḍa la bh+rūm̐:
de nas lha rnams so sor gang 'dod bskyed:

hūm̐: sku gsum rtsa brgyud bla ma spyan 'dren no: yi dam lha tshogs ma lus spyan 'dren no: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kun ma lus spyan 'dren no: chos skyong nor lha grogs mdzad spyan 'dren no: badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: hūm̐: sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i gdan steng du: rtsa brgyud bla ma ma lus bzhugs su gsol: nyi zla pad+ma brjid pa'i gdan steng du: yi dam lha tshogs thams cad bzhugs su gsol: sna tshogs rin chen pad+ma'i gdan steng du: mkha' 'gro thams cad dgyes par bzhugs su gsol: pad+ma nyi ma bam ro'i gdan steng du: chos skyong srung ma thams cad bzhugs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad dang: chos skyong nor lha dam can rgya mtsho la: bdag gis rab tu gus dang dang ba yi: lus ngag yid gsum dad pas phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang: nor lha dam can gter bdag thams cad la: mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos dang: mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo 'bul: gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim ro mngar dang: reg bya 'jam pa bdag gis mchod pa 'bul: ye shes lnga yi bdud rtsi chen po dang: ba liṃ gtor ma'i zhal zas brjid pa dang: khams gsum bsgral pa'i rak+ta mchod par 'bul: sku gsung thugs kyi rig ma dkar dmar mthing: shin tu mdzes pa lta na sdug pa la: rin chen dar zab mang po'i rgyan gyis brgyan:

rtsa ba gsum la bdag gis mchod par bgyi: log 'dren dgra bgegs bstan la gnod byed rnams: chos kyi dbyings su bdag gis bsgral byas te: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: ar+ghaṃ: pā d+yaṃ: puṣ+pe: dhū pe: ā lo ke: gan+dhe: nai wid+yā: shab+da: rū pa: shab+da: gan+dhe: ra sa: spar+she: a mṛta: ba liṃ ta: rak+ta: mu drā: ma traṃ ru tra pra we sha ya kha kha khā hi khā hi: hūm̐: dad ldan bu la byin rlabs char 'beb pa'i: bla ma'i lha tshogs kun la bstod par bgyi: dngos grub ma lus lhun gyis grub mdzad pa'i: yi dam kun la bdag gis bstod par bgyi: 'gro ba snang srid dbang du sdud mdzad pa'i: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bdag gis bstod par bgyi: bstan pa bsrung ba'i las la rab tu brtson: chos skyong kun la bdag gis bstod par bgyi: dgos 'dod re ba skong bar mdzad pa yi: nor lha'i tshogs la bdag gis bstod par bgyi: bstan la gnod byed sgrol bar mdzad pa yi: dam can tshogs la bdag gis bstod par bgyi: hūm̐: bla ma rnams la 'byor tshogs chung ba bshags: yi dam lha la spang len byas pa bshags: mkha' 'gro rnams la gsang ba bsgrags pa bshags: chos skyong rnams la mchod gtor chung ba bshags: tshangs pa chen po'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol:
de nas so so'i dzap bsnyen bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas tshogs kyi rim pa ni:

hūm̐: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: raṃ las me 'phros dngos 'dzin bsregs: yaṃ las rlung byung bag chags gtor: khaṃ las chu byung gnyis 'dzin bkrus: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum 'od du zhu: bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gar gyur: hūm̐: sku gsum rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: yi dam lha tshogs ma lus pa: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs thams cad kun: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: chos skyong srung ma ma lus pa: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: nor lha dam can rgya mtsho rnams: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: tshogs gtor 'di la byin gyis rlobs: rnal 'byor bsam pa bsgrub tu gsol: rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhes su gsol: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa bshags: dam sri gnod byed zhal du bstab: gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi:
de nas tshogs spel lhag ma ni:

oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za dur bdag mo: lhag la dbang ba'i 'byung po gtor len ni: lhag ma 'di bzhes gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams: thams cad rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: hūm̐: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma yis: lha srin dam la btags pa rnams: sngon gyi dam bcas ma g.yel bar: brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: brtan ma bcu gnyis dam la btags: bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar: brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ma ma hrīṃ hrīṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi khā hi: hūm̐: sku gsum bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog: mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi bkra shis shog: gter srung dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: snang srid ma lus rang gi sku la bsdu: rang nyid thugs ka'i sngags 'khor la thim nas: de yang de dbus hūm̐ dang hrīḥl thim: hūm̐ dang hrīḥyang mi dmigs nam mkha' ltar:

zhes brjod de yi ngang la mnyam par gzhag: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ: gu h+ya: gya mang: ྈ zhes pa sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gsum gser 'phyang gi lo/ cho 'phrul chen po'i zla ba'i tshes bdun nyin thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho zhal gzigs te/ rtsa gsum spyi'i las byang 'di nyid dngos su bka' bstsal pa 'di skye 'gro thams cad dge ba'i rgyur gyur cig /
